issue.title: Don't allow ESLint >=2.10.0

repository.name: p5play
repository.description: JavaScript game engine that uses q5.js/p5.js for graphics and Box2D for physics.

issue.body:
A [regression in ESLint](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/6173) causes false positives from the max-statements-per-line rule.  So far versions 2.10.0-2.10.2 are affected.

[The fix](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/pull/6192) has been merged and seems likely to land in 2.10.3.  Once that happens we should update our depedency to allow >= the fixed version.

issue.title: Support ESLint >= 2.10.3 (if regression is fixed)

repository.name: p5play
repository.description: JavaScript game engine that uses q5.js/p5.js for graphics and Box2D for physics.

issue.body: We dropped support for ESLint >= 2.10.0 in #92 due to a [regression causing a false positive when linting our code](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/6173).  The [fix for the regression has been merged to master](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/pull/6192) so it should probably go out with 2.10.3.   Once that happens, we should update our dependency to allow the newer versions with the fix.
